hero.title: Design crafted for businesses that want to look as strong as they are.
hero.lead: A graphic design studio creating high-impact print, packaging, and digital brand systems.

intro.title: Built for brands that need to be seen
intro.lead: We work with growing companies across wellness, retail, toys, and trade. Whether you need a campaign poster or a full visual identity, we keep the work clear, consistent, and ready to use.
intro.printDesc: Brochures, posters, flyers, and labels prepared for print — clean layouts, correct sizes, and files your printer can actually use.
intro.digitalDesc: Social images, ads, and web-ready artwork that stay sharp on every screen and stay on-brand across channels.
intro.identityDesc: Logo, colour, and brand systems so every poster, pack, and profile looks like it belongs to the same company.

services.title: One studio for print, digital, and branding
services.lead: One brief, one team, and one visual language — from first sketch to files you can send to print or post online.
services.brochuresDesc: Product catalogues, company profiles, and fold-outs that explain what you do without looking crowded.
services.postersDesc: Event, retail, and campaign pieces designed to stop people in the aisle, the feed, or the street.
services.digitalDesc: Social posts, banners, and web visuals sized and styled for the platforms your customers already use.
services.labelsDesc: Product labels and pack graphics that read clearly on the shelf and hold up in production.

pillars.localDesc: Visuals that feel right for your market — Ayurvedic, retail, toys, and trade brands included.
pillars.deliveryDesc: Structured files, print-ready exports, and revisions that stay organised as the work grows.
pillars.controlDesc: Colour, type, and logo rules so every new poster still looks like you.

ctaBand.title: Start a brand, or tighten the one you have
ctaBand.lead: Branding with us means logo, colour selection, posters, and the supporting pieces that make a company look finished — not pieced together.

simplify.title: A simple way to work with a design studio
simplify.lead: Clear briefs, structured rounds, and files you can keep using long after the first campaign.
simplify.step1Desc: Tell us the piece, the audience, and the deadline. We shape the direction before we draw.
simplify.step2Desc: Concepts for logo, colour, layout, and type — then we refine until it is ready to ship.
simplify.step3Desc: We extend the system across posters, flyers, labels, and digital so nothing feels like an afterthought.
simplify.step4Desc: Print-ready and web-ready files, with notes so your team can keep using the brand.

clients.title: Trusted by teams that sell every day
clients.lead: From Ayurvedic houses to toys and international trade — we design work their customers actually see.

clients.kottakkalDesc: Visual work for a heritage Ayurvedic name in market.
clients.welltechDesc: Corporate and product graphics for a global-facing team.
clients.petsOriginDesc: Packaging and campaign pieces for a pet brand.
clients.oggyToyDesc: Playful, high-energy graphics for a toy brand.
clients.newDelmonDesc: Retail-ready design for a storefront and product range.
clients.alJazeeraDesc: Packaging, labels, and commercial brand assets for a premium food distribution company.

news.studioTitle: Full branding, not just a logo file
news.studioDesc: Logo, colour selection, posters, and the rest of the system — so your next flyer already has a home.
news.campaignTitle: From one poster to a full campaign
news.campaignDesc: Brochures, flyers, labels, and digital images that share one look — useful when you need to move quickly without looking messy.

contact.title: Tell us what you need designed
contact.lead: Brochure, poster, flyer, digital image, label, logo, or a full branding programme. Send a short note and we will come back with next steps.
contact.messagePlaceholder: Tell us about the brand, the piece, and the deadline.
contact.statusSuccess: Opening your email app to send the message.
